question: Rio De Janeiro is named by _______ as world capital of architecture for 2020?
solution: The correct answer is __**UNESCO**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • **UNESCO** stands for the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization. • UNESCO is responsible for coordinating international cooperation in education, science, culture, and communication. • In 2018, UNESCO launched the initiative of designating a World Capital of Architecture to celebrate architecture and urban planning. • Rio De Janeiro was named the World Capital of Architecture for 2020, highlighting its rich architectural heritage and its role in global architectural innovation.
